name: "✨ Feature Request"
about: "Suggest an idea, enhancement, or new statutory capability for HRMS"
title: "[FEAT] <Short description>"
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## 🎯 Problem Statement
A clear description of what problem this feature solves (e.g. *As a Payroll Admin, I need...*).

## 💡 Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how you envision the user experience.

## 📦 Impacted Modules & Roles
- **Modules**: [e.g. Leave Management, Payroll Engine, Statutory Register]
- **Target Roles**: [e.g. Employee, Manager, HR Admin]

## 🔒 Security & RBAC Permissions
- [ ] Requires new permission code(s) (e.g. `leave.special_grant`)
- [ ] Modifies existing role permissions
- [ ] No RBAC changes required

## 🗄️ Database / Schema Impact
- [ ] Requires new SQL table / column
- [ ] Requires new database trigger or stored procedure
- [ ] No database changes required

## 📋 Additional Context / Reference
Add any mockups, statutory references (e.g. EPFO/ESIC circulars), or architectural context here.
